raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On >=130 GiB GPUs (H200, B200, B300), sglang's own 2-GPU LTX-2.5 two-stage cookbook preset (`--pipeline-class-name LTX2TwoStagePipeline`) does not start:

```
LTX-2 two-stage requires resolution divisible by 64, got (544x960)
```

The cause is the default size:

- `LTX25SamplingParams` defaults to 960x544. That is the one-stage canvas, and the two-stage pipeline uses it too.
- `LTX2HalveResolutionStage` needs each side to be a multiple of 64, so 960x544 cannot be halved.
- On these GPUs BCG is on by default for `LTX2TwoStagePipeline`, and its warmup runs at the sampling default, so startup fails.
- A two-stage request that omits its size fails the same way.

This was found by serving the 1920x1088, 121-frame two-stage workload with the cookbook command on 2x H200 and 4x B200.

## Modifications

- `configs/sample/ltx_2_5.py`: `LTX25SamplingParams` names its two-stage canvas (`two_stage_default_size = (1920, 1088)`, the official two-stage default). `_adjust` applies it under the two-stage pipeline when the request sets neither width nor height; an explicit size still wins.
  - The change stays in LTX-2.5's own sampling params. The per-pipeline registry is keyed by class name alone, so registering `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` for LTX-2.5 would also have changed LTX-2 and LTX-2.3.
- `runtime/warmup_request_builder.py`: the LTX two-stage warmup path reads the same canvas, so BCG captures the shape two-stage serves. As a guard for any other model, the BCG warmup no longer takes an LTX-2 two-stage default that the halve stage would reject; it falls through to the aligned representative shape.

## Accuracy Tests

No numerical change. An explicit request size is used as before, and one-stage LTX-2.5 keeps 960x544.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

2x H200: the cookbook preset with no size flags, LTX-2.5 distilled, two-stage, 1920x1088, 121 frames. The harness warms up 3 requests at 3 steps, then times 2 requests by the client.

| sglang | Result |
| --- | --- |
| main at 3a01d4cc, preset | server exits during warmup (error above) |
| this branch, preset | 9.396 s |
| main at 3a01d4cc, explicit `--width 1920 --height 1088` | 9.435 s |

The same preset also fails at 3a01d4cc on 2x B200, in the same way.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). `test_cfg_parallel_warmup.py` has 3 new tests; 58 passed on this branch rebased onto d2cf2371b0, on B200.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed: the cookbook preset now works as documented.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

@@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
 import dataclasses
+from typing import Any, ClassVar
 
 from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.ltx_2 import LTX2SamplingParams
 
@@ -37,6 +38,24 @@ class LTX25SamplingParams(LTX2SamplingParams):
     # reported step count honest.
     num_inference_steps: int = 8
 
+    # The two-stage pipeline generates at half resolution and refines back up;
+    # its default is the official two-stage canvas. 960x544 above is the
+    # one-stage default, and two-stage cannot halve it: LTX2HalveResolutionStage
+    # needs each side to be a multiple of 64. The warmup builder reads this too.
+    two_stage_default_size: ClassVar[tuple[int, int]] = (1920, 1088)
+
+    def _adjust(self, server_args: Any) -> None:
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import (
+            is_ltx2_two_stage_pipeline_name,
+        )
+
+        explicit = getattr(self, "_explicit_fields", None) or set()
+        if is_ltx2_two_stage_pipeline_name(
+            getattr(server_args, "pipeline_class_name", None)
+        ) and not explicit & {"width", "height"}:
+            self.width, self.height = self.two_stage_default_size
+        super()._adjust(server_args)
+
     @classmethod
     def video_request_extra_fields(cls) -> frozenset[str]:
         return frozenset(

@@ -127,11 +127,26 @@ def _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
     """
     width = sampling_defaults.width
     height = sampling_defaults.height
+    two_stage = is_ltx2_two_stage_pipeline_name(server_args.pipeline_class_name)
+    if two_stage and getattr(sampling_defaults, "two_stage_default_size", None):
+        # LTX-2.5's sampling default is its one-stage canvas (960x544), which
+        # the two-stage halve stage rejects; BCG warmup at it failed the start.
+        width, height = sampling_defaults.two_stage_default_size
     is_image_gen = server_args.pipeline_config.task_type.is_image_gen()
+    # Any other LTX-2 two-stage default the halve stage would reject falls
+    # through to the aligned representative shape instead of failing warmup.
+    alignment = _warmup_resolution_alignment(server_args) if two_stage else 1
+    servable_default = not (
+        two_stage
+        and width is not None
+        and height is not None
+        and (width % alignment or height % alignment)
+    )
     # graphs replay only the captured shape, so BCG skips the video area cap
     if (
         width is not None
         and height is not None
+        and servable_default
         and (
             not server_based_warmup
             or is_image_gen

@@ -69,6 +69,7 @@
     _resolve_default_warmup_resolution,
     _resolve_warmup_num_frames,
     build_warmup_reqs,
+    get_model_sampling_defaults,
     should_include_warmup_image,
     supports_synthetic_warmup,
 )
@@ -893,6 +894,70 @@ def test_ltx2_two_stage_warmup_uses_pipeline_alignment(self):
         self.assertEqual(reqs[0].num_frames, 25)
         server_args.pipeline_config.adjust_num_frames.assert_called_once_with(25)
 
+    def test_ltx25_two_stage_request_defaults_to_the_two_stage_canvas(self):
+        def adjusted(pipeline_class_name, **explicit):
+            params = LTX25SamplingParams(**explicit)
+            params._explicit_fields = set(explicit)
+            with patch.object(SamplingParams, "_adjust"):
+                params._adjust(SimpleNamespace(pipeline_class_name=pipeline_class_name))
+            return params.width, params.height
+
+        self.assertEqual(adjusted("LTX2Pipeline"), (960, 544))
+        self.assertEqual(adjusted(None), (960, 544))
+        self.assertEqual(adjusted("LTX2TwoStagePipeline"), (1920, 1088))
+        # An explicit size still wins.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            adjusted("LTX2TwoStagePipeline", width=1280, height=704), (1280, 704)
+        )
+
+    def test_ltx25_two_stage_bcg_warmup_uses_the_two_stage_canvas(self):
+        # BCG is on by default for LTX-2 two-stage on >=130 GiB GPUs and warms
+        # up at the sampling default; 960x544 used to fail the halve stage.
+        server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+            pipeline_config=LTX25PipelineConfig(),
+            pipeline_class_name="LTX2TwoStagePipeline",
+            model_path="Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers",
+            model_id=None,
+            backend="sglang",
+            warmup_sampling_params=None,
+            enable_breakable_cuda_graph=True,
+        )
+        with patch.object(
+            SamplingParams, "from_pretrained", return_value=LTX25SamplingParams()
+        ):
+            defaults = get_model_sampling_defaults(server_args)
+
+        self.assertEqual((defaults.width, defaults.height), (960, 544))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
+                server_args, defaults, server_based_warmup=True
+            ),
+            (1920, 1088),
+        )
+        server_args.pipeline_class_name = "LTX2Pipeline"
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
+                server_args, defaults, server_based_warmup=True
+            ),
+            (960, 544),
+        )
+
+    def test_ltx2_two_stage_bcg_skips_an_unhalvable_default(self):
+        server_args = MagicMock()
+        server_args.pipeline_class_name = "LTX2TwoStagePipeline"
+        server_args.enable_breakable_cuda_graph = True
+        server_args.pipeline_config.task_type = ModelTaskType.T2V
+        server_args.pipeline_config.vae_scale_factor = 32
+        sampling_defaults = SamplingParams(width=960, height=544, num_frames=121)
+
+        width, height = _resolve_default_warmup_resolution(
+            server_args, sampling_defaults, server_based_warmup=True
+        )
+
+        self.assertNotEqual((width, height), (960, 544))
+        self.assertEqual(width % 64, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(height % 64, 0)
+
     def test_ltx2_two_stage_single_gpu_keeps_generic_frame_cap(self):
         server_args = MagicMock()
         server_args.pipeline_class_name = "LTX2TwoStagePipeline"
